title: Seems like a nice pillow, but made my son's neck hurt
text: Seems like a nice pillow, but made my son's neck hurt. This pillow comes rolled up and then expands to full size once you take it out of the wrapping.  The pillow has a nice feel to it, but my son said that after one night of sleeping on it, his neck hurt.  Apparently the pillow doesn't yield enough and I think he found that it elevated his neck too much.  It is nice that it is hypoallergenic and that it has a washable cover.  If you are okay with a really firm pillow and familiar with memory foam, this could be a good pillow for you.  It didn't work for us.  In fairness, we didn't follow instructions to run it for 10 minutes in a dryer with a couple dryer sheets, as the instructions said to do.  I don't know what that does, but maybe it helps break in the pillow or softens it.  Maybe we will try that and see if it makes any difference.  If so, I'll try to update this review.
